subtitle: Geometric Operators That Rewrite the Mind and Shape Reality

blocks.explanation: The mind is the internal statistical manifold encoding a generative model; consciousness is the recursive integration where expected free energy models the entity's own states; breath and bandhas are geometric operators that rewrite the metric tensor and restructure the attractor landscape. Frequency modulation acts as metric damping — high-frequency chaos, baroreflex-resonance lock near 0.1 Hz, and low-frequency absorption. Kumbhaka (retention) opens a free-energy null-space; the bandhas act as hydraulic topological gates coupling visceral receptors to mind geometry. A generative grammar of breath lets a practitioner programmatically reshape the geometry of consciousness.
